reason: I already pay for a booking tool and I will not switch calendars for a chatbot. Another monthly subscription I may not use, and I would not hand my customer chats to something I cannot see working.
objection: Does it book into the calendar I already use, or just into a Google or Outlook calendar nobody in my salon looks at?
would_change_my_mind: It syncs straight into the Fresha or Cliniko calendar I already run, with a free trial that proves it books real appointments.
